summary.en: Gate signal protocol (flux-gate/1) and the gate_signal field move into the shared contracts so skills can report pending human decisions in headless runs.
summary.pt: Protocolo de sinal de gate (flux-gate/1) e campo gate_signal entram nos contratos shared, para as skills sinalizarem decisão humana pendente em execuções headless.

summary.en: The review gate can now post and approve a PR in one choice, pinned to the reviewed commit, plus a mechanical polling gate for the iterate watch.
summary.pt: O gate do review passa a postar e aprovar a PR numa só escolha, presa ao commit revisado, e o watch do iterate ganha um gate mecânico de polling.
